model: ROLEX GMT-Master II 126713GRNR (40 mm steel and yellow gold Rolesor, black dial, grey and black Cerachrom 24 h bezel with gold coin edge, date with Cyclops lens, gold GMT hand, Jubilee bracelet with gold centre links)
note: Follower of the GMT-Master II 40 template (126710BLNR): same step / prep / kit preset (read-only), per-photo measure / spec / job only. Gold parts (rim, coin edge, crown, centre links, hands) are photo pixels of the projected steel map: no separate material. Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. GMT-Master II 40 template (126710BLNR first; 126720VTNR left crown / Oyster, 126711CHNR Everose two-tone, 126713GRNR Jubilee, 126710BLRO Oyster follow: they change model, note, trace, dial_map, steel_map, emissions, the bracelet layout and, for 126720VTNR, a mirrored crown side): the Submariner Date 41 build (rotating coin-edge bezel with a flat polished rim, Cyclops lens at 3 o'clock) at 40 mm with a 60-flute coin edge, FOUR hands (the GMT hand = blue shaft + triangle head, one traced polygon between the hour and the minute hand) and a five-column Jubilee bracelet (outer / inner / centre / inner / outer) whose joints are measured per column, top and bottom. Case and lugs with crown guards from the photo silhouette; the ceramic insert (24 h scale, numerals, triangle and the blue / black split come from the projected steel photo), polished rim ring and fluted coin edge, domed crystal, traced hand outlines, fluted crown on its axis and the Jubilee links; dial, indices, print, date window and numeral and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 23.14 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 903.5 = 22.49 mm, lug bottom y 1992.5 = 24.57 mm, crown guards to x 1472 = 22.13 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: 24 h ceramic insert (bezel_in 15.83 .. insert_out 18.84 mm; blue / black split and numerals are texture), flat polished rim to rim_out 19.14, coin edge (60 flutes) from there to the tips at 20.0 mm sloping down to z_coin_out

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons, the GMT hand (blue shaft + triangle head) between hour and minute hand; the lume, Mercedes lines, blue colour and black facets stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (guards are in the case slab): flutes x 1428..1488, cap to 1514, axis 0.6 mm below the pivot, 16 coarse flutes

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Jubilee bracelet, five columns (outer brushed, three polished: inner / centre / inner; the two inner columns share one piece list). Joint rows (px, 23.14 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)), read from 4x crops with 10 px ticks and column-mean brightness runs, top and bottom separately: outer top 883.5 / 799 / 734.5 / 696 (the steps of the brushed links in the alpha silhouette, dark overlap lines in the photo), end 684.4; outer bottom 2132 / 2255 / 2359 / 2442 / 2505, end 2514.4; inner top 846.5 / 769 / 718 / 690.5 and bottom 2097 / 2217 / 2319 / 2400 / 2462 (the thin dark band that precedes each bright plate; the broad black bands inside a plate are reflections, not joints); centre top 892 / 804 / 739 / 702 / 689.5 and bottom 2145 / 2241.5 / 2347.5 / 2429 / 2505.5 (the centre links are staggered by half a pitch against the inner ones; the pitch grows by ~25 px per link toward the lugs). Column lines x 860.8 / 926.2 / 992.5 / 1058.4 (top) and 860.4 / 926 / 993.5 / 1058.8 (bottom): gradient maxima on 4-6 row bands. The inner and centre columns start at 18 mm under the case. Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette (the nested rounded tops of the brushed links).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

date.note: Cyclops lens: photographed outline (measure.date.lens_px) as a wall + two bevel rings + flat top above the crystal; photo projection; heights are scaled by pose.depth_scale like every part
